title: Our Vibrant Country
lesson: To understand ‘Our Vibrant Country’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on India’s geographic and cultural diversity and languages and traditions, then look for evidence for food and clothing diversity. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
